nodes.label: Camera Coherence Plan
nodes.rationale: Make the camera obey one rule — preserve the user's view on every game lifecycle event (start, round advance, end); the reveal animation is the only place the camera intentionally moves. Four independently revertable commits.

nodes.label: Preserve-the-user's-view camera rule
nodes.rationale: Two flyTo(DEFAULT_*) effects (App-level game-start and the reveal hook's round-start) yanked the camera away from wherever the user had navigated. Deleting both makes one coherent rule instead of per-lifecycle-event exceptions; the round-start flyTo test is rewritten as an anti-test asserting flyTo is NOT called on game start.

nodes.label: line-gradient reveal animation
nodes.rationale: Replaces the per-frame setData + jumpTo rAF loop with a one-shot full-arc setData plus a single easeTo camera and per-frame setPaintProperty('line-gradient'), using lineMetrics:true and line-progress. Moves per-frame cost off geometry rebuilds and onto a paint property, which the GPU already interpolates.

nodes.label: initialCameraView property removal
nodes.rationale: Once both camera resets are deleted, the per-mode initialCameraView ('preserve' for country-pinning, 'world' for city-guessing) and the mode parameter on useRevealMapEffects have no readers — vestigial state that would otherwise re-invite the deleted behaviour.

nodes.label: Reveal-artifact cleanup on round transition
nodes.rationale: The round-ended cleanup only cleared some reveals; both city reveals and country wrong-guesses draw the same sources, so clearRevealSources must fire unconditionally at the round boundary or stale arcs/markers survive into the next round.
